newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent differentials firm in Chicago.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent differentials firm in Chicago.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel basis firmed in Chicago on Friday, ending a slide that began earlier in the week, traders said.
Traders said Midwest prices would be driven mostly by changes in the NYMEX futures in the coming week, with turnaronds not expected to be a factor in the market.
"Those should all be factored in the market right now," one trader said.
Discussion remained muted as traders returned from an industry gathering sponsored by Conoco in Texas that pulled several key players out of the market this week, traders said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline was heard done 1.35 cents a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries with premium talked 2.75 cents higher.
Group Three unleaded remained 1.0/0.75 cent under for prompt deliveries and 1.50/1.25 cent under for later deliveries, with premium steady at 3.50 cents higher.
Low sulphur diesel firmed to 2.50/2.25 cents under the print for all October timings in Chicago, and high sulphur firmed to 4.25 cents under the print.
Low sulphur was talked even to 0.25 cent over the print in Group Three for prompt deliveries and 0.25 cent under to even with the print for later deliveries.
